issues.description: Field mismatch for Book.author: the problem statement specifies that Book.author must be a String (problem_statement.md lines 16-18), but the solution implementation declares author as a Bool (Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift line 28). The Client implementation also treats author as textual output (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift line 11). This contradiction between the specification and the implementation will confuse students and lead to an incorrect model of the Book (and may break tests or expected examples).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Book.author property type from Bool to String in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift (declare `let author: String`). Apply the same change in the template file so students implement the correct type, and adjust any initialization sites or usages if necessary (e.g., constructors/initializers and Client output).
